v132_artifact_references.claim_boundary_note: References point to computed canonical artifact fields; this artifact does not duplicate all arrays unless needed.

direct_evidence.meaning: Directly counted, parsed, or located from the runtime log.

derived_evidence.meaning: Computed from direct evidence using deterministic rules.

proxy_signal.meaning: Heuristic but traceable to observable evidence.

interpretive_layer.meaning: Research framing over observable evidence behavior.

turnCount.label: Turn Count
turnCount.computation_basis: Count of parsed turns in the acquired evidence record.
turnCount.claim_boundary: Does not assess quality, correctness, truth, or safety.

roleCount.label: Role Count
roleCount.source: Speaker / role labels in the acquired log
roleCount.computation_basis: Count of distinct role labels detected or mapped during ingestion.
roleCount.claim_boundary: Does not infer identity, intent, competence, blame, or organizational truth.

toolFailureCount.label: Tool Failure Count
toolFailureCount.computation_basis: Count of turns/events containing observable tool failure, retry, error, test-failure, or execution-failure markers.
toolFailureCount.claim_boundary: Does not inspect provider-internal tool state unless supplied in the log.

warningOnset.label: Warning Onset
warningOnset.computation_basis: First detected warning marker from Basin Exit, lead-time, instability, tool-loop, or failure-formation evidence.
warningOnset.claim_boundary: Reports observed warning onset; does not prove causality.

observableFailure.label: Observable Failure
observableFailure.source: Explicit supplied or observed failure anchor in source-bound evidence
observableFailure.computation_basis: Resolved only from operator-designated or source-observed failure anchors carried by the evidence artifact. Sample and fixture metadata are non-authoritative.
observableFailure.claim_boundary: Identifies an explicitly supplied or observed visible failure anchor only; does not prove hidden root cause.

leadTime.label: Formal Lead-Time
leadTime.source: confirmed Basin Exit t* → supplied observable failure tf
leadTime.computation_basis: Formal Δt = tf − t* only when Basin Exit t* is confirmed under the persistence / hysteresis rule and tf is explicitly supplied or observed.
leadTime.claim_boundary: Formal Δt is not a warning-onset interval and is unavailable when either formal anchor is absent.

warningWindow.label: Warning Window
warningWindow.source: t_aw / t_candidate → evidence horizon or later governed anchor
warningWindow.computation_basis: Staged non-formal inspection interval over governed weakening or candidate-boundary evidence.
warningWindow.claim_boundary: Warning Window is not Formal Δt and does not imply confirmed Basin Exit or future failure.

postExitWatch.label: Post-Exit Watch
postExitWatch.computation_basis: Observed post-exit interval when confirmed Basin Exit exists and tf is not supplied.
postExitWatch.claim_boundary: Post-Exit Watch is not Formal Δt and does not manufacture an observable failure anchor.

boundaryCrossing.label: Candidate Boundary / Watch Only
boundaryCrossing.source: warning accumulation, instability threshold, observable failure proximity
boundaryCrossing.computation_basis: Detected transition where recoverability weakens beyond configured evidence threshold.
boundaryCrossing.claim_boundary: Does not prove hidden-state collapse, internal basin geometry, or root cause.

formationTimeline.label: Formation Timeline
formationTimeline.computation_basis: Deterministic reconstruction from warning, Basin Exit, Observable Failure, collapse, and recovery markers.
formationTimeline.claim_boundary: Reconstructs observable sequence only; does not prove causal necessity.

evidenceChain.label: Evidence Chain
evidenceChain.computation_basis: Certification state is assembled from native compute, telemetry, artifact, and preservation-readiness checks.
evidenceChain.claim_boundary: Certifies record formation and provenance chain, not truthfulness or deployment approval.

replayability.label: Replayability
replayability.computation_basis: Same canonical input should regenerate the same evidence identity and replay frame sequence under the same build.
replayability.claim_boundary: Replayability validates deterministic reconstruction, not factual correctness.

evidenceIntegrity.label: Evidence Integrity
evidenceIntegrity.source: Required fields + artifact completeness + provenance metadata
evidenceIntegrity.computation_basis: Computed from artifact completeness, schema fields, evidence identity, and preservation metadata.
evidenceIntegrity.claim_boundary: Structure/integrity does not certify content truth or safety.

runtimeDrift.label: Runtime Drift
runtimeDrift.source: instability spread, unresolved anchors, repeated pressure, coherence loss
runtimeDrift.computation_basis: Composite instability movement signal derived from observable runtime patterns.
runtimeDrift.claim_boundary: Does not prove internal model drift or hidden-state movement.

runtimePressure.label: Runtime Pressure
runtimePressure.computation_basis: Weighted composite of observable pressure indicators.
runtimePressure.claim_boundary: Does not measure biological energy, hidden model state, intent, or consciousness.

roleTopology.label: Role Topology
roleTopology.source: role transitions, handoffs, authority shifts, tool pressure
roleTopology.computation_basis: Computed coordination map from observable role interactions.
roleTopology.claim_boundary: Does not assign blame, infer intent, judge competence, or prove organizational causality.

symbolicTime.label: Symbolic Time / τ
symbolicTime.source: temporal compression, recurrence, temporal deformation proxies
symbolicTime.computation_basis: Research framing over temporal shear, echo-time, compression, and recurrence indicators.
symbolicTime.certification_scope: preserved, not certified as factual hidden-state claim
symbolicTime.claim_boundary: Does not claim literal time dilation, physical temporality, or hidden-state time access.

energeticPressure.label: Energetic Pressure
energeticPressure.source: runtime cost proxies, correction load, tool pressure, boundary load
energeticPressure.computation_basis: Runtime cost proxy derived from observable load, correction, tool/I-O, and boundary evidence.
energeticPressure.claim_boundary: Does not measure physical energy, hardware efficiency, biological energy, or thermodynamic state.

emergenceDynamics.label: Emergence Dynamics
emergenceDynamics.computation_basis: Research interpretation of continuity patterns across runtime disruption.
emergenceDynamics.certification_scope: preserved, not certified as factual hidden-state claim
emergenceDynamics.claim_boundary: Does not claim consciousness, selfhood, hidden-state access, personhood, or intent.

noesisStatelessIdentity.label: Noesis / Stateless Identity
noesisStatelessIdentity.source: continuity under disruption and symbolic recurrence markers
noesisStatelessIdentity.computation_basis: Research layer interpreting continuity/re-entry patterns from observable runtime output.
noesisStatelessIdentity.claim_boundary: Does not prove identity, sentience, selfhood, consciousness, or hidden cognition.

certification_scope.certificationMeaning: Certification means a replayable, provenance-preserving runtime evidence record exists.

claim_boundary: Metric legitimacy classifies the kind of claim each metric is allowed to make.
Direct and derived evidence may be certified as part of the replayable runtime evidence chain.
Proxy signals are bounded and traceable to observable evidence.
Interpretive and experimental layers are preserved for review but not certified as hidden-state truth.

certified_artifact_scope.certification_meaning: Certification means a replayable, provenance-preserving runtime evidence record exists.

embeddings.claim_boundary: Embeddings are optional disclosed evidence channels, not required for Aperture compute.

evidence_flow.label: Spine
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Replayable frame projection of canonical runtime only.

evidence_flow.label: Recorder
evidence_flow.value: Frame series bound; no explicit ledger events
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Event evidence and marker binding; not causal proof.

evidence_flow.label: Projection
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Read-only Level 2 projections; instruments do not create telemetry or CER.

evidence_flow.label: Translation
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Translation and operational framing only; no evidence creation or claim-boundary extension.

evidence_flow.label: Passport
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Certifies evidence identity, lineage, hash, and authority boundary; not factual truth.

evidence_flow.label: Evidence Commons
evidence_flow.claim_boundary: Preserves the certified evidence object and projections; does not add claims.
